To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the TSP with triangle inequalities is a very hard problem, but it is still possible to obtain good approximation algorithms; 2) the TSP is even harder with the triangle inequality, but it is possible to obtain good approximations; and 3) the TSP can be solved exactly in polynomial time if we have a good estimate of the optimal solution.
